channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq tick higher as traders monitor Iran; Sandisk shares fall: Live updates
item.description: The S&P 500 was relatively unchanged on Thursday, while the Nasdaq Composite pulled back as traders kept an eye on the Middle East.

item.title: Ford's new 'Fathom' electric pickup truck will start at $28,000
item.description: It's the first vehicle to be built using the "Universal Electric Vehicle" platform that Ford has said is key to making money with EVs.

item.title: SpaceX stock could face further pressure as first batch of shares unlock since IPO
item.description: With the first tranche of SpaceX shares held by insiders unlocking, the stock could see downward pressure.

item.title: Fox won't renegotiate NFL media rights before current deal expires, CEO Lachlan Murdoch says
item.description: Fox has decided not to renegotiate its current TV deal with the NFL until the expiration of the league's opt-out clause in 2030, said CEO Lachlan Murdoch.

item.title: 'AI Kill Switch' bill needs to be passed this year amid ongoing rogue agent hacks, Rep. Lieu says
item.description: Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI have all had incidents of AI models hacking other companies during cybersecurity testing.

item.title: Top tech analyst Mahaney sees 45% upside for this food delivery platform
item.description: DoorDash could gain more ground as order volume grows and it focuses on a robust subscriber base, Evercore ISI says.

item.title: Versant shares surge 10% after company raises 2026 outlook on platforms, advertising momentum
item.description: Versant noted revenue growth in its platforms business, which includes Fandango and GolfNow, and now, the recent acquisition of Full Swing.

item.title: The divide between Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk is widening after their latest earnings
item.description: As Lilly widens its lead in the obesity race, Novo is still racing to win back market share and restore investor confidence in its pipeline.

item.title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns of high leverage: 'Somebody will disrupt the market'
item.description: JPMorgan Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon warned that leverage across financial markets remains elevated, adding that investors should be mindful that hidden borrowing could amplify market disruptions.

item.title: Traders on Kalshi now think it's likely that the S&P 500 will hit 8,000 in 2026
item.description: The rise in odds come after the broad index hit record highs in a more than 5% four-day rally that ended Wednesday.

item.title: Google is expanding its AI empire — and losing the people who built it
item.description: Google’s cloud boom is testing the company's commitment to frontier AI as commercial returns take priority.

item.title: Opinion: Demis Hassabis’ new role exposes Google’s AI balancing act
item.description: Demis Hassabis’ new role highlights the tension between his scientific ambitions and Google’s pressure to commercialize and scale AI.

item.title: Apollo agrees to buy UK airline EasyJet in $7.7 billion deal as Castlelake withdraws
item.description: EasyJet shares tumbled Thursday after Castlelake said it would not be bidding for the U.K. airline.

item.title: Ukraine’s military hits one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries in long-range drone attack
item.description: The Slavneft-Yanos facility in Yaroslavl, which is situated hundreds of miles from the Ukraine border, is one of Russia's biggest oil refineries.

item.title: World's biggest spirits maker pops 4% on $1 billion cost-cutting plan
item.description: Diageo, whose brands include Johnnie Walker scotch whisky, Captain Morgan rum and Guinness stout, said costs relating to the savings program will amount to $1.2 billion.

item.title: JPMorgan adds this 'unloved' value stock to its favorite buys list
item.description: JPMorgan sees huge upside for this speciality materials company.

item.title: Restaurant Brands International earnings beat as Burger King's U.S. business soars
item.description: Burger King's U.S. business reported same-store sales growth of 8.5%.

item.title: Family offices back clean energy and sustainability startups in July as dealmaking holds steady
item.description: Private investment firms of John Doerr and other billionaires are backing geothermal energy, nylon recycling and more.

item.title: Peloton posts first-ever annual net profit, but shares drop as outlook disappoints
item.description: Peloton delivered its first-ever annual profit in fiscal 2026 but it's still working to generate sales growth as consumers pull back on big ticket purchases.

item.title: Khanna to introduce 'Data Center Bill of Rights' as fight over AI power plants heats up
item.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, who won a competitive primary Tuesday, has endorsed state and local moratoriums on data centers.

item.title: We're exiting our position in a spin-off play gone wrong
item.description: It will take time to restore credibility with investors after a disappointing first earnings report.

item.title: Can a side hustle help you stop living paycheck to paycheck? It can, with the right tools and a plan
item.description: Here are the best products for starting a side hustle and the money move to make once you earn more.

item.title: Inheriting a home can leave siblings with financial headaches — how to avoid costly mistakes
item.description: Siblings inheriting a home can face difficult choices over selling, renting or keeping the property.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal says WNBA players' treatment of Caitlin Clark is a rite of passage
item.description: Harsh fouls against Clark and WNBA officiating have fueled a national debate, with some lawmakers demanding accountability from the league.

item.title: NASA engineer spent $200 to start a side hustle from her closet—now it brings in over $32,000 a month
item.description: Voiceover actor Eryn Andrews brings in more money from her side hustle than her full-time human performance engineering job at NASA. Here's how she got started.

item.title: Megayacht Amadea sold for $187 million to Dubai billionaire with Trump ties
item.description: The sale of the Amadea caps a turbulent and controversial history for the 348-foot yacht, which was seized from a sanctioned Russian oligarch.

item.title: Mexican jalapenos tied to Salmonella outbreak in 27 U.S. states
item.description: U.S. health officials are investigating a Salmonella outbreak linked to Mexican jalapeno peppers that has sickened 345 people in 27 states.

item.title: EU urges Caribbean nations to shut down golden passport programs or face travel restrictions
Warner Bros. Discovery reports 10% jump in streaming revenue ahead of proposed Paramount combination
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming segment surpassed $3 million in revenue for the second quarter, marking a 10% increase from the year prior

item.title: Hadrian valued at nearly $8 billion after fresh funding as money pours into defense tech
item.description: Hadrian is one of a number of defense tech startups raising large sums and benefiting from President Trump's plans to upgrade the U.S. military.
